violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

A sponge and a spray bottle were observed in/hanging on the hand-washing sink in the service area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Items were removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Various cakes and empanadas were observed not marked with the date taken from freezer and defrosted. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The door to the outside, located at the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026
cases of syrups were observed stored on the floor in the service area and basement storage. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was 100 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quaternary ammonia sanitizer is 200-400 ppm. PIC informed, sanitizer added. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. PIC placed utensils in hot water during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Cases of single service items were observed stored on the floor in the basement storage area. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2026

The refuse area was observed with an accumulation of trash and debris. Refuse areas must be maintained clean and free of debris to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026

The outside dumpsters are not covered, observed with overflowing trash. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

The door to the outside, located at the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Technician was on-site and informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026
Cases of single service items were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen and service areas. New Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2026

A low-boy in the service area was observed in poor repair, with an ambient temperature of 64 degrees. PIC stated warranty claim has been made; awaiting technician and/or replacement. New Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026
The area surrounding the shared dumpsters has an accumulation of trash debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026
